description:
We are looking for an HR & Office Administrative Assistant to join our clients growingteam. In your role as an HR & Office Administrative Assistant, you will report to the Global HR Manager. To support the office culture and logistics, you will be required to work from the office 3 days a week, with every Wednesday being an all company day, with the remaining two days worked remotely.

You will be responsible for managing end-to-end office operations and serving as a key operational hub for HR and employee experience.

Office Logistics & Facilities:
- Vendor Management: Acting as the primary point of contact for the landlord and
- external vendors, such as electricians and plumbers.
- Supply Management: Managing the ordering of office supplies and maintaining
- inventory.
- Health & Safety: Ensuring the office remains a safe environment and staying compliant
- with health and safety standards.
- Team Events: Coordinating team lunches and planning events for the Summer and
- Christmas parties, as well as smaller ad-hoc gatherings.
- General Admin: Providing general business administration support to ensure efficient
- operations.

HR & Employee Lifecycle
- HR Data & Systems Management: Maintain HR software by accurately inputting
- employee details and tracking annual leave, sickness, and attendance
- Recruitment Assistance: Providing assistance with recruitment and candidate sourcing,
- screening, and referencing.
- Onboarding & Offboarding: Assisting with the onboarding and offboarding of
- employees to ensure a seamless transition for all staff.
- Policy Guidance: Developing a strong knowledge and understanding of company
- policies to provide accurate advice and support to the team. Assist in drafting, updating,
- and implementing HR policies
- HR Research & Initiatives: Assisting with research on upcoming HR initiatives and
- providing administrative support for the People team.
- Travel & Scheduling: Managing team travel arrangements and booking meetings and
- candidate interviews.

Requirements
- Up to 2 years of experience in a similar administrative or HR role.
- Communication: Have excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with
- internal teams and external stakeholders.
- Soft Skills: Leverage emotional intelligence and active listening skills to work harmoniously and
- effectively with others.
- Organisation: Be diligent and attentive to detail with a strong ability to resolve issues in a timely and
- efficient manner.
- Tech Savvy: Be adept at working with Microsoft Office/G-Suite and comfortable working with
- different technologies.
- Attitude: Have a "can do" attitude to taking on new challenges

Are you ready to support a dynamic maintenance team while making a real difference in people's lives? Kisharon Langdon UK has an exciting Maintenance Support Administrator opportunity!

Location: Colindale, North West London, NW9 6 TD

Salary: 35,000 per annum

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

Hours: 36 hours per week

Closing Date: 13th September 2026

About Us:

Kisharon Langdon are a charity offering a wider breadth of services of enhanced quality, enabling us to better support people with a learning disability and autistic people and their families. From nursery and school to further education, through to employment opportunities and supported living, Kisharon Langdon will enable people with a learning disability and autistic people to thrive and realise their ambitions and aspirations.

Whilst we support the Jewish community, we celebrate and benefit from the diversity of the communities in which we are based and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Maintenance Support Administrator - The Role:

You will oversee the Help Desk function, managing reactive maintenance work orders and ensuring data accuracy within our facilities management system. Working closely with the Estates team and external contractors, you will coordinate job paperwork, maintain maintenance contracts, monitor stock levels, and assist with procurement activities.

Your role will drive system optimization, produce service level reports, and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure timely completion of work and best value for the organisation.

Maintenance Support Administrator - Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee Help Desk operations, reporting and assigning reactive maintenance work orders with accurate data management
- Ensure complete job paperwork and provide maintenance reports including KPI and service level metrics
- Maintain all maintenance contracts within the facilities management system
- Monitor, control and track stock alongside the Estates team
- Source and negotiate supplier contracts, managing procurement for quality, price and terms
- Liaise with contractors to ensure timely work order closure
- Research and evaluate new products and maintain strong vendor relationships

Maintenance Support Administrator - You:
- Help Desk experience with a trade background, capable of offering basic problem-solving advice
- Experience determining necessary goods, services and equipment for organisations
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with strong analytical thinking
- Self-motivated problem-solver able to work independently and as part of a team under pressure
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general IT skills with meticulous attention to detail
- Strong prioritisation skills and ability to adapt to manage change

Benefits:
- 21 days holiday increasing with length of service, plus bank holidays and Major Jewish holidays
- Pension scheme via NatWest Cushion
- Blue light card providing access to 15,000 discounts from national and local retailers
- Eyecare benefits via Vision Express
- Long service recognition and rewards with employer referral bonus
- Season ticket loan and Bike 2 Work scheme
- Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Programme with free counselling and support
- Development and career progression opportunities

Closing Date: 13th September 2026

Please Note: We reserve the right depending on the number of applications received, to shortlist and interview candidates prior to the closing date.

All candidates will need to have the right to work in the UK and we cannot offer Visa sponsorship at this time.

This post is subject to a Standard Disclosure Application to the Disclosure and Barring Service.

To submit your CV for this exciting Maintenance Support Administrator opportunity, click Apply today!

title: Bank Medical Secretary
description:
Bank Medical Secretary St Anthony's Hospital Private Hospital Bank Sutton

Spire St Anthony's Hospital is currently recruiting for a Bank Medical Secretary to join their team on a bank, zero-hour contract

Founded in 1904, Spire St Anthony's Hospital delivers care through skilled and dedicated staff working together. With a completed £27m development investment, we provide very high quality healthcare to patients around Sutton, Epsom, Surrey and South London.

Duties and responsibilities:

To provide a proficient and professional medical service to consultants, providing cover as and when required to other members of the department. Acting as point of contact for patient enquiries, offering outstanding customer service at all times.
- Providing an efficient and timely secretarial service to assigned consultants and any other associated teams.
- Liaising with patients on a daily basis, handling queries and arranging admissions as and when required, in a professional and courteous manner
- Liaising with insurance companies and other external agencies, as appropriate
- Production of medical letters, operation/clinic notes and discharge summaries.
- Arranging completion of claim forms, if required, with relevant consultant, ensuring all financial paperwork is kept up to date
- Developing good working relationships with consultants, administration teams, nursing staff and any other departments
- Manage outpatient bookings, where required, ensuring the appointments process runs smoothly
- Manage Consultants' records and filing
- Undertake all work in accordance with company hospital policies and procedures. Ensuring familiarity with the Health and Safety at Work Act, including manual handling and fire procedures
- To maintain confidentiality of all information acquitted with regard to patients, consultants and staff and not on any account disclose information about the affairs of the hospital, its subsidiaries or associates
- Provide and receive patient information, ensuring that all patient information is provided, received and recorded in accordance with the Data Protection Act and Spire policies.
- To present a professional, smart image at all times, ensuring adherence to hospital uniform policy
- Carry out any other duty that reasonably falls within the general nature and level of responsibility of the post.

Who we're looking for:
- Audio skills
- Good standard of secondary education with demonstrable literacy and numeracy skills
- Track record of successful delivery in a similar role, with experience in a wide range of secretarial duties

Benefits:

We offer employed colleagues a competitive salary as well as a comprehensive benefits package which includes but is not limited to:
- 35 days annual leave inclusive of bank holidays (Pro Rata)
- Employer and employee contributory pension with flexible retirement options
- 'Spire for you' reward platform - discount and cashback for over 1000 retailers
- Free Bupa wellness screening
- Private medical insurance
- Life assurance

Our Values:

We are extremely proud of our heritage in private healthcare and of our values as an organisation:
- Driving clinical excellence
- Doing the right thing
- Caring is our passion.
- Keeping it simple
- Delivering on our promises
- Succeeding and celebrating together

We commit to our employees' well-being through work life balance, on-going development, support and reward.

"Spire Healthcare is a leading independent healthcare group in the United Kingdom, running 38 hospitals and over 50 clinics across England, Wales and Scotland. It provides diagnostics, inpatient, day case and outpatient care, operates a network of private GPs and provides workplace health services to over 800 corporate clients. It also delivers a range of private and NHS mental health, musculoskeletal and dermatological services."

Our vision is to be recognised as a world class healthcare business bringing together the best people who are dedicated to developing excellent clinical environments and delivering the highest quality patient care.

We are looking for an Office Assistant to help run the day-to-day administration of a small but growing consultancy. This is a varied, hands-on role and no two days are likely to be exactly the same. The position is deliberately broad, with duties evolving as the company grows and as we work out what additional support the team needs. This could be an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who is organised, capable and keen to learn.

Key Responsibilities

The role will include a mixture of office, administrative and organisational duties, including:
- Taking responsibility for the smooth day-to-day running of the office.
- Helping to get the new office fully set up and operational, including ordering equipment and supplies such as printers, monitors and other office essentials.
- Providing general administrative support to the directors and consultants.
- Preparing, formatting and sending letters, reports and other documents.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post and correspondence.
- Liaising with clients, building managers, suppliers and other contacts.

- Organising meetings, including Teams calls and meeting rooms.

- Assisting with invoices, payments, expenses, ordering and other basic financial administration.
- Ordering office equipment and supplies and making sure the office has what it needs to operate effectively.
- Helping to set up and maintain office systems as the business develops.
- Assisting with IT and general office administration, including liaising with external suppliers where required.
- Providing ad hoc support to the team as and when needed.

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Organised - able to keep track of different tasks and deadlines.
- Proactive - someone who spots what needs doing rather than always waiting to be asked.
- Positive and willing to learn - happy to pick things up and ask questions.
- Technically confident - comfortable using computers and everyday office software, and willing to learn new systems.
- Practical and adaptable - able to move between different tasks depending on what the business needs.
- Reliable and conscientious - someone the team can depend on.

- A good communicator - comfortable dealing with colleagues and external contacts.
- Someone with common sense - able to look at a task and work out the sensible next step.
- A team player - happy to work closely with a small, friendly group of consultants and directors.

What We Offer
- Salary of 30,000- 35,000, depending on experience.
- 35-hour working week.
- Hybrid working, with one/ two days per week from home.
- 24 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Three additional days off over Christmas.
- Pension.
- Private healthcare.
- Life assurance.
- Income protection.
- Life assurance of up to four times salary.
- Support for relevant professional accreditations and development.
- A friendly, relaxed and supportive working environment.
- The opportunity to join a growing business in a newly created role and make it your own.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Job Title: HR Assistant/PA to the Headteacher

Hours: 17.5 hours per week

Reporting to: Operations Manager/The Headteacher

Contract type: 08:00 to 12 noon Mon to Fri - Term time only

Main purpose:

As the HR Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring HR processes run efficiently and in line with school policies and safeguarding requirements. You will manage HR administration, support recruitment processes, and maintain accurate staff records.

Duties and responsibilities:

Human Resources
- Maintaining accurate and confidential HR records e.g. staff files, contracts, DBS, absence records.
- Supporting the recruitment process including preparing job adverts, collating applications,arranging interviews, and onboarding.
- Processing starters, leavers, and contract variations.
- Assisting with the administration of payroll changes and liaising with payroll providers as necessary.
- Supporting induction and training records for staff.
- Managing staff absence returns and maintaining the Single Central Record (SCR).
- Assisting in staff communications and providing general HR-related advice and support under the guidance of the Operations Manager.
- Ensuring HR processes and data handling comply with safeguarding, confidentiality, and 0 GDPR policies.

Personal Assistant (PA)
- Manage the Headteacher's diary, ensuring effective communication and coordination.
- Maintain staff supervision records and ensure they are carried out on time.
- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Headteacher.

General Administration
- Respond to telephone enquiries, directing queries appropriately to relevant staff members.
- Handling reprographic tasks and providing general administrative support within the school office.

Other Duties/Responsibilities:
- Be a proactive member of the Operations team.
- Attend staff meetings, appraisals, and professional development activities.
- Support general office administration duties as appropriate to the post.
- Contribute to whole school development plans and maintain high standards in daily duties.

Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills:
- A good standard of general education (GCSEs & A-Levels) or relevant vocational qualifications.
- Previous experience of working in an educational setting (desirable but not essential depending on experience).

Knowledge and Skills:
- Discretion and ability to maintain confidentiality in all HR matters.
- Understanding and commitment to safeguarding and data protection.
- Excellent analytical and data extraction skills.
- Ability to manage pressure and maintain a positive, solution-focused attitude.
- Strong numeracy and attention to detail.
- Ability to take initiative and manage workload independently.
- Strong interpersonal and team-working skills.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively.
- Integrity, professionalism, and commitment to the school's vision.
- Prior experience in finance and administration (education sector experience desirable).
- Proficiency in accounting software (FMS desirable), and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
- Experience using HR systems or databases desirable but training can be given.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Understanding of HR policies and best practices.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
Position: Training Coordinator (Events)

Hours: 9am-5pm, Monday to Friday

Location: London Bridge / Hybrid working

About Us

At the Knowledge Exchange Group, we don't just talk about the issues shaping UK public policy - we get the right people in the room to solve them. Across our three brands, Westminster Insight, Holyrood Insight, and Policy Wales, we deliver over 100 conferences and 150 training courses a year, giving public sector and policy professionals the insight, tools, and connections they need to make a real difference. Our client list speaks for itself - from government departments and public sector bodies to charities doing genuinely meaningful work, right through to some of the biggest household names in UK private industry.

If you are highly organised, love the buzz of bringing people together and want a role where every project is different, keep reading.

The Role

We're looking for a Training Coordinator to join our fast-paced, friendly events team - someone who thrives on organisation, enjoys a full inbox, and gets a real kick out of seeing a training course come together from a blank page to course full of engaged delegates.

Whether it's a small, focused workshop of 5 or a full course of 30, our training courses are designed to engage every delegate.You'll be working closely with our Director and the marketing, product, and operations teams to make sure every course lands well, and appeals to a mix of clients.

No two days will look the same, and while some experience in event coordination is great, what matters most is your drive, your eye for detail, your passion for good customer experience, and solid negotiation and organisational skills. We'll provide full training and teach you the rest.

What You'll Be Doing
- Building and nurturing relationships with trainers and industry bodies
- Negotiating trainer fees and keeping projects on budget
- Working with trainers to shape course content - chasing bios, materials, logos and slides
- Building course websites and email campaigns
- Coordinating pre-event questionnaires to keep content sharp and relevant
- Securing CPD certification for our courses
- Supporting delegates - joining instructions, tech troubleshooting, and friendly customer service
- Gathering feedback and evaluation post-course to keep raising the bar
- Handling cost and invoice admin
- Liaising directly with clients on bespoke in-house training

About You
- At least a year's experience in a professional environment
- Some background in events or training
- Confident with everyday tech - Microsoft Office, Zoom, email systems, etc.
- Sharp organisational skills - checking the details, meeting multiple deadlines
- Experience with email marketing or website builders is a bonus
- A natural at customer service - warm, helpful, and solutions-focused
- Comfortable negotiating and thinking commercially
- A calm problem-solver who takes things in their stride
- A genuine team player who builds relationships easily
- A clear, confident communicator

What You'll Get
- 23 days' annual holiday, rising to 25 after 2 years and 28 after 3
- 2 dedicated personal development days plus access to CPD-accredited training
- Company pension scheme
- Regular company social events
- Hybrid working
- A genuinely dynamic, supportive, and agile team to be part of
- Progression within the role and the company.

About Missing People

Somebody goes missing in the UK every 90 seconds. Missing People exists to ease the heartache experienced by those missing someone, and to help people who are away from home find their way back to safety. Our vision is for every missing child, adult and family left behind to find help, hope and a safe way to reconnect. We are a non-judgemental, highly skilled team of staff and volunteers working for everyone who needs us. We provide free, confidential support, help and advice by phone, email, text and live chat.

The Content Coordinator will play a key role in developing engaging, audience-led content across Missing People's owned communications channels. Working as part of our award-winning Marketing and Communications Team, you will help bring our services, stories and campaigns to life across our website, social media, email marketing and other digital platforms. You will work with colleagues, volunteers, content creators and people with lived experience of missing to create accessible, impactful content that grows awareness, supports engagement and helps more people find the information and support they need.

The impact you will have

Your work will help missing children, adults and families affected by disappearance to access trusted information, support and services when they need them most. By creating compelling website, social media, video and e-newsletter content, you will increase understanding of the issue of missing, strengthen Missing People's profile and help grow the communities of supporters who make our work possible. You will also help ensure our online spaces are managed safely, our communications are coordinated and consistent, and our content reflects the voices and needs of those we support.

About you

You will be highly organised, enjoy working with systems and data, and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work. You will find full details of what we are looking for in the attached job description, and key requirements are:

Experience:
- Significant experience of planning and creating innovative and inspiring content that shares and amplifies the voices and experiences of service users or customers - from briefing, insight and planning to creation and delivery.
- Experience of writing SEO, AIO GEO and AEO and user experienced informed website content.
- Experience of developing and managing content plans.
- Experience in planning and creating engaging social media content shaped by insight (video for social, images, blog posts, storytelling, live video), following brand style and tone of voice;
- Experience of creating and editing short-form video content for social media platforms.
- Experience of confidently and collaboratively managing a range of stakeholders including internal colleagues and external contacts.

Skills and Knowledge:
- A solid understanding of the social media landscape, emerging channels and trends.
- Exceptional ability to create and tailor content to different audiences and platforms, including a variety of mediums such as written, visual and video;
- Strong copywriting and editing skills
- Ability to take complex information and turn it into accessible communications for the wider public;
- Creative ability for storytelling through words, images and design.
- A good understanding of managing online communities safely.

Right to work in the UK.

What you will get in return

Missing People is a friendly and supportive place to work - it's a welcoming, caring organisation which really makes a difference to people affected by the issue of missing throughout the UK. We offer generous paid holidays, a range of enhanced family friendly benefits and are happy to talk about flexible working in most roles.

Find out more and apply

Support the Senior Receptionist with prescription processing and provide cover during periods of absence. i. Complete all tasks within the Reception and personal inboxes on a daily basis. j. Manage the new patient registration email inbox and ensure all required documentation is received. k. Register new and temporary patients and accurately enter patient information onto the clinical system. l. Support the Reception Team in arranging hospital transport for patients attending their first outpatient appointment. w. Carry out general reception administration duties to support the Reception Team. x. Monitor and maintain the reception area, patient notice boards and information leaflets. y. Manage the cervical screening deferral process. z. Complete routine practice audits, including: Fire extinguisher checks (monthly) First aid box checks (quarterly) Vaccine fridge monitoring (weekly) Inventory checks (quarterly) Defibrillator checks (daily) aa. The Administrative Assistant will also undertake Medical Secretary duties, including: a. Typing letters, reports and other clinical documentation as required. b. HAMPSTEAD GROUP PRACTICE Title: Medical Administrator Accountable to: Practice Manager Reports to: Practice Manager Liases with: Patients and Users of the Practice Professional Members of the Practice Team Patient Services Team and administrative staff PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE To provide efficient and effective administrative and secretarial support to the partners and medical staff of the practice. title: Medical Receptionist
description: Law Medical Group Practice, is seeking a reliable and organised Receptionist to join our team. The practice is committed to delivering high-quality primary care services to our local community and supporting patients through efficient administrative and reception support systems. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the multidisciplinary team by undertaking a range of reception and patient-facing duties. This includes managing appointments through EMIS, handling patient queries, processing incoming correspondence, and ensuring that important information is accurately directed to the relevant clinicians. The role will involve front-of-house responsibilities, including welcoming and directing patients, responding to queries, and assisting patients both in person and over the phone in a professional and efficient manner. Working Pattern: This role can be offered on either a full-time or part-time basis, as per the below schedules: Full-time: Monday - Friday: 11:00am - 7:00pm or Part-time: Monday, Wednesday & Friday: 1:30pm - 7:00pm Tuesday: 1:00pm - 7:00pm Thursday: 1:30pm - 6:30pm Please note: The above working days and hours are strictly non-negotiable. Eligibility: This position is open only to UK citizens with a minimum of 5 years working experience in the UK. The role involves providing comprehensive reception support to the multidisciplinary team within the practice. Key responsibilities include managing patient interactions, handling incoming correspondence, and ensuring accurate distribution of information to clinicians. The position includes front-desk duties such as greeting and directing patients, managing the appointment system using EMIS , booking appointments, responding to patient enquiries, and supporting the smooth and efficient day-to-day operation of the practice. The following are the core responsibilities of the Medical Receptionist . There may occasionally be a requirement to carry out other duties depending on workload, operational needs, and staffing levels. Primary Responsibilities Receive and process correspondence from hospitals, external healthcare providers, and other agencies. Scan and upload documents onto the EMIS clinical system, ensuring accurate patient record management. Review and appropriately allocate documents within EMIS , forwarding them to the relevant clinician for review and action. Initiate and respond to requests from patients, practice staff, and external healthcare agencies in a professional and timely manner. Photocopy and prepare documentation as required by clinicians and practice staff. Provide cover for colleagues during periods of absence to ensure continuity of service. Accurately input patient information and updates into EMIS where required. Manage and resolve patient queries efficiently, escalating issues where appropriate. Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient reception environment at all times. Support the clinical team with day-to-day operational tasks as required. Complete tasks relating to patient results, correspondence, and clinical letters where appropriate. Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in managing changing workloads and priorities to ensure the smooth operation of the practice. Use EMIS and other digital systems effectively for patient record management, appointment scheduling, and internal communication. Secondary Responsibilities In addition to the primary responsibilities, the Medical Receptionist may also be required to: Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system using EMIS . Process appointment requests received in person, by telephone, and via online systems. Answer incoming telephone calls and direct them appropriately or deal with enquiries where possible. Signpost patients to the appropriate healthcare professional or NHS service. Support practice audits and administrative reviews as directed by management. Process incoming electronic communications and documents where required. Scan and attach patient-related documentation accurately to patient records within EMIS . Carry out opening and closing procedures in accordance with the practice rota and operational requirements.

title: Practice Administrator
description: We are recruiting for part time administrator at our practice based in Clapham, SW4. This is for maternity leave cover with a minimum of 9 months contract which may be extended up to 1 year. The successful applicant must be able to start mid October and must have experience of managing SARS/Insurance reports/DWP forms etc. 12 hours per week- 4 hours per day to be worked between 9am-5pm. Working days will be Monday/Wednesday & Friday Hourly Rate: £14.80 per hour. The successful applicant will be an integral part of our Primary Care team, supporting the delivery of high standard patient care. As the first point of contact for our patients and and outside agencies, they will have excellent customer service skills, experience and/or an excellent understanding of managing medical reports, SARS and letter requests from outside agencies- Solicitors/DWP/Insurance companies- & our patients and the associated processes. Managing all aspects of Medical Reports/SARS/Private letters and forms Managing the IGPR system and software Liaising with patients and practice staff in relation to the above Ordering supplies for the practice- medical, stationery, toners. Providing support to our administrator and reception team as required. The successful candidate will be required to be flexible, providing cover for annual leave and sick leave. PREVIOUS APPLICANTS NEED NOT APPLY The key responsibilities for this role are: Assisting our Registration Clerk with the processing of online registrations RESPONSIBLE TO: Assistant Practice Manager The primary role of the practice administrator is to manage requests made to the practice for Medical Reports and SARS requests, in addition to these duties, the post holder will be required to provide urgent cover for our registration administrator as directed by the Assistant Practice Manager. The post holder must have an excellent understanding of Access to Medical Records and Data protection. In addition, excellent IT skills are required and experience of using IGPR software is desired but not essential. It is important that all members of staff are prepared to take on additional duties or relinquish existing duties to maintain efficient running of the practice and changes in how services are provided. The Partners reserve the right to redistribute duties and functions among members of staff from time to time and requests for such changes shall not be reasonably refused. Duties and Responsibilities Managing and processing requests for Medical Reports and SARS requests Ensure upon receipt of requests for SARS and Medical Reports, all details are logged onto spreadsheet and reviewing and updating accordingly. Responsible for processing requests within specific time frames & following correct process. Manage requests for completion of private forms and requests for letters. Including discussing fees with both patients and clinicians. Manage requests from outside agencies for reports such as Child Protection/ Police Manage and maintain the IGPR data and software. Be the liaison between insurance companies and patients in relation viewing reports prior to sending. Responsible for redacting record entries relating to SARS and liaise with clinicians as required. First point of contact for patients in relation to requests and queries relating to private letters/completion forms Managing and responding to tasks sent by reception & clinical team in a timely manner. Ordering supplies: Responsible for the ordering of stationery, medical and IT supplies, ensuring stock is managed effectively and storeroom well maintained. . Other Duties : Provide cover in the absence of the registration administrator, ensuring all online registrations via Health Tec1 software, are processed, as required and instructed by the Assistant Practice Manager. Education Attend practice meetings. Attend suitable educational courses outside the practice. Attend training sessions within the practice. Complete mandatory Practice Index modules as required Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice health & safety policy, the practice health & safety manual, and the practice infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, with such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate This job description will be reviewed at your regular staff appraisal. PERSON SPECIFICATION Essential Desirable Excellent IT skills including Excel/ Word Working knowledge of EMIS Excellent Knowledge of Data Protection and Access to Medical Records Working knowledge of Docman/Accurx Aptitude to learn new software & processes Working knowledge of IGPR software Excellent time management & organisational skills Previous experience of working within the NHS Excellent customer service skills Knowledge of NHS registration processes Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team. Excellent communication skills both written and verbal It is the policy of Hetherington Group Practice that no job applicant or employee shall receive less favourable treatment than another on the grounds of sex, marital status, age, disability, race, religion, creed, colour, national origin or sexual orientation. This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. You must therefore disclose all spent and unspent convictions, cautions, reprimands and final warnings. If you are offered the post we will need to obtain a satisfactory DBS disclosure for you.

title: Receptionist - GP Surgery
description: This is not for locum agencies For queries, please email i.sanghera@nhs.net Southall Medical Centre has an exciting new vacancy for a part-time (20-25 hours/week) receptionist / administrator to join our dynamic admin team! No prior GP practice experience is required, however the ideal candidate must be familiar with the role of primary care / GPs in the NHS. Good IT and computer skills are essential for this position. Key responsibilities and duties include: Triaging appointment requests and booking appointments appropriately for patients Handling incoming telephone calls to the surgery Processing repeat prescriptions according to practice policy Scanning and processing medical documents through SystmOne (clinical system) Completing tasks set by the practice manager and the doctors / clinicians Opening and closing front doors in line with opening times Greeting patients kindly and courteously Working as part of a team collaboratively with other team members Preparing the surgery, waiting area, consulting rooms in preparation for clinics You must be a friendly, courteous people-person as this role primarily involves handling patient queries and have a strong work-ethic and resolve to help provide excellent patient care, in line with our practice vision. Ability to speak Panjabi, Hindi, Gujarati or Urdu would also be extremely beneficial for this position. The role of reception / administrator is mainly an administrative role, and requires excellent people-person and communication skills, due to the patient-facing nature of the role. Duties and responsibilities of receptionists include, but are not limited to: appointments, handling telephone calls, document workflows, processing repeat prescription requests, completing tasks set by practice manager or doctors, opening/closing front doors, maintaining cleanliness of waiting area and consulting rooms, keeping noticeboards and patient areas up-to-date, working collaboratively as part of our practice team. The ideal candidate will have some experience of the NHS, however no previous GP surgery employment is required. Strong work-ethic, commitment to the role, flexibility and efficiency are key traits in a successful applicant. Although you will be well-supported by our existing administrative and management team, you must be able to work independently, autonomously, with a problem-solving and can-do attitude. As the first port of call for our patients, a friendly and warm welcome and excellent communication skills are crucial to this role. The surgery is fully computerised, so good IT and computer skills are a necessity. Successful applicants will be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) as well as SystmOne (clinical system training provided).
